description: Tethys converts regional water-demand projections into finer spatial and temporal inputs using sector-specific proxies and formulae. The version 2.1.0 release documents fixes, contribution guidance and changes made during JOSS review. This resource is provided by Isaac Thompson; Vernon, Chris R.; Khan, Zarrar. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: bsd-2-clause-netbsd. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Downscaled demand depends on input projections and proxy assumptions; it is not direct local water-use observation. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: data-tethys-conus-gridded-water-demand-1980-2100. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
